name: Cosette
source:
"Just for one day, please be my mom!"

Elliot's beloved only daughter. She's outgoing and gets along with everyone easily. She may not show it in public, but she's a spoiled child who loves her papa.

[Translated from [url=http://mintwings.web.fc2.com/m03/character.html]official website[/url]]
